message.en:
The biggest update in the history of WARDOGS Artillery Calculator is here!

• Completely rebuilt the Bakurani map system
• Recalibrated coordinates to match in-game values
• Corrected map scale, distance and artillery calculations
• Added higher-detail map zoom levels
• Added zoom-based marker visibility
• Added a fully redesigned mobile interface with touchscreen support
• Added automatic mobile routing

This is not just an upscale — the map system itself has been fundamentally rebuilt.
